hints.title: 2D Prefix Sums
hints.text: Precompute 2D prefix sums of the matrix to query the sum of any square submatrix in constant time.

hints.title: Monotonicity of Square Sums
hints.text: Because all matrix elements are non-negative, larger squares have equal or greater sums.

hints.title: Check Square Feasibility
hints.text: Use binary search on the side length L from 1 to min(M, N). If any L x L square has sum <= threshold, L is achievable.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Summing square regions repeatedly without prefix sums takes cubic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A 2D prefix table computes any square sum in O(1), enabling logarithmic search on side length.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate correctly implements inclusion-exclusion 2D prefix sum and checks square bounds.
complexity.notes: Can also be solved in O(M * N) by expanding side length greedily without binary search.

solutions.approach: 2D prefix sums with binary search on side length
